details.label: Discussion
details.text: A slow moving cluster of thunderstorms continues to evolve eastward along north/south combining outflow boundaries. Occasional gusts of 50-60 mph have been reported. Ahead of the ongoing convection, a precipitation shield has developed. Nocturnal cooling and increasing MLCIN are noted ahead of the line across central Nebraska. Nonetheless, 00z observed sounding from OAX would suggest that appreciable MUCAPE is available downstream. VAD profiles across Oklahoma and Kansas are starting to sample the increasing 30-35 kt southerly low-level jet (LLJ). This is forecast to further increase and nudge into portions of southern Nebraska over the next couple of hours. Hi-res and ensemble guidance continue to suggest that some increase in intensity of convection will be possible as this occurs, with potential for damaging wind to continue across central Nebraska after 06z
